//: spark's own breadboard surface for a board drawn from its own record (P412): 63 columns, the half board's pitch, first column and rows. The columns are the PO's word, 2026-10-29; the model is not recorded. Its rails (P953) are a drawing convention, as covers_holes is in data/wokwi-geometry.json, not a measured fact: four rails of 50 holes in blocks of 5, each hole on a column's x, + above - on both sides as on Wokwi's half board, each pair 3 pitches from its outer row of holes. Wokwi-measured facts stay in data/wokwi-geometry.json.
//palette: The breadboard picture's colours (P953), from the old wiring page of the README (pixel-master/docs/wiring.html): the page, the board's body and edge, the gap between the halves, the holes, the rail holes, the + and - rails' lines and signs, the letters and numbers, and the titles. Another look is another palette here, with no code.
//sizes_px: The picture's sizes in px at spark's 9.6 px pitch: the old page's (18 px pitch) times 9.6 / 18. board_pad is the space from the outermost hole to the board's edge, gap_band the gap's height, rail_line_off how far a rail's line lies off its holes, numbers_every which columns get a number (and column 1).

full.//body_gap_columns: The free columns the planner keeps between two part bodies (P953, the PO's 'leave space in between elements', 2026-11-20), room for the wires between them. Wokwi's half board has none, so its layout stays the one Wokwi was shown.
